en: I am Drake, the last of the Elite Four. I sailed the seas for many years before I came to the dragons.
To command Dragon-type Pokémon, a trainer needs one thing above all. Do you know what it is?
If you don't, you will not get past me. Come! Show me what you have!
Superb. You have it, the thing my dragons and I look for in a trainer: a true bond with your Pokémon.
Go on through. The Champion waits at the end of the hall. Give it everything you have.
Why do you linger here? The Champion is waiting for you.
